normalization.provenance: slab_protocol_v1.json: RMS of full-angle worm_004 development slab, frozen before this split; never recompute from reserved clean targets

model.padding: zero; no ordinary angular circular padding
model.activation: ReLU after first three convolutions; linear output

training.selection: lowest mean across four files of mean across eight familiar masks of missing-ray relative L2, pooled over eight slices per file/mask; first epoch wins exact ties
training.loss: mean squared error on missing clean rays only

integration_gate.selection: choose learned arm by familiar validation relative L2 only, mask arm wins exact tie

integration.prior: baseline acquired-only multiscale initializer shared by all arms
integration.selection: existing converged-candidate acquired-objective rule; failures retained

reserved_policy: No reserved files opened in first training/validation phase. Evaluate unseen masks on validation only after checkpoint selection.json is saved. Reserved grid requires separately recorded assessment budget and frozen adapter.
input_contract: Same 25x62 point-sampled grid for all arms. Noise is generated at100x310 per file/z/epoch before sparse selection; no extra acquired pixels enter model or initializer. Coordinates use historical pixel centres, spacing2/310. Completion preserves measured float64 values; neural tensors are float32. Acquired arrays for Gaussian arms are shared float64 copies.
limitations: One synthetic organism, provisional numeric-ID grouping; no genealogical independence.
Fixed development scale differs from historical per-case acquired-RMS scaling; old reconstruction errors are not paired controls.
No physical density, voxel truth, Bayesian calibration or test-time adaptation claim.
